sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于得知了她的名字——阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是档案档案呈献的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Warnings, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 温馨提示，本集的节目须知请查看您所用应用上的说明，或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，并不适合所有听众收听。

sentences.en: What is this that I can see?
sentences.zh: 我能看到的是什么？

sentences.en: Cold icy hands taking hold of me.
sentences.zh: 冰冷的手将我紧紧抓牢。

sentences.en: For death has come, you all can see.
sentences.zh: 因为死亡已经降临，你们所有人都能看到。

sentences.en: Hell has opened its gate to trick me.
sentences.zh: 地狱已敞开大门来捉弄我。

sentences.en: Oh death, oh death, can't you spare me over for another year?
sentences.zh: 哦，死神，哦，死神，难道你不能再多留我一年吗？

sentences.en: I'll stuff your jaws till you can't talk.
sentences.zh: 我会塞住你的下巴，让你无法言语。

sentences.en: I'll bind your legs till you can't walk.
sentences.zh: 我要捆住你的双腿，让你无法行走。

sentences.en: I'll tie your hands till you can't make a stand.
sentences.zh: 我要绑起你的双手，让你无法反抗。

sentences.en: And finally, I'll close your eyes so you can't see.
sentences.zh: 最后，我会闭上你的双眼，让你什么也看不见。

sentences.en: I'll bring sexual death unto you for me.
sentences.zh: 我要为你带来专属于我的性窒息死亡。

sentences.en: The poem arrived on Friday, February 10, 1978, two months after the murder of Nancy Fox.
sentences.zh: 这首诗于1978年2月10日星期五送达，也就是南希·福克斯遇害两个月后。

sentences.en: It was delivered in an envelope addressed to the studio office of local Kansas news television station, Cake TV.
sentences.zh: 信件装在一个信封里，寄到了堪萨斯州当地新闻电视台“蛋糕电视”的工作室办公室。

sentences.en: Titled, Oh Death to Nancy, the poem was a twisted parody of the folk song, Oh Death, in which a man pleads with the grim reaper to spare his life.
sentences.zh: 这首诗题为《致南希之死》，是对民歌《哦，死神》的扭曲戏仿，在歌中，一名男子恳求死神饶他一命。

sentences.en: Listed four times along the left margin were the letters BTK, each paired with a small, hand-drawn hangman's noose.
sentences.zh: 左侧边缘列出了四次“BTK”字样，每个字样旁边都配有一个手绘的小型绞刑套索。

sentences.en: He had also included a highly detailed sketch of a partially naked woman bound face down on a bed, depicting Nancy Fox's body with striking accuracy.
sentences.zh: 他还附上了一张细节极其丰富的素描，画中是一名半裸女子被反绑在床上，极为精准地描绘了南希·福克斯的尸体。

sentences.en: The scene was further brought to life in an accompanying two-page typewritten letter marked by BTK's characteristic poor spelling and grammar.
sentences.zh: 随信附上的一封两页打字信更将这一场景生动地重现出来，信中带有BTK标志性的拼写和语法错误。

sentences.en: It described the layout of Nancy's apartment, the clothes she was wearing, how her body was positioned and restrained, and the condition of her belongings,
sentences.zh: 信中描述了南希公寓的布局、她穿的衣服、她尸体的位置和受限状态，以及她物品的状况，

sentences.en: including the theft of her driver's license.
sentences.zh: 包括她驾驶证被盗一事。

sentences.en: These were details only Nancy's killer could have known.
sentences.zh: 这些细节只有南希的凶手才会知道。

sentences.en: The letter contained unreported details from Shirley Vianne's crime scene as well.
sentences.zh: 信中还包含了雪莉·维安妮案发现场未公开的细节。

sentences.en: BTK claimed responsibility for Shirley's murder too, admitting he had planned to kill Shirley's three young children by suffocating the boys with plastic bags and hanging the girl.
sentences.zh: BTK也宣称对雪莉的谋杀负责，并承认他曾计划用塑料袋闷死男孩、吊死女孩的方式杀死雪莉的三个年幼孩子。

sentences.en: He lamented that it would have been a, quote, beautiful sexual relief to do so,
sentences.zh: 他感叹这样做会带来一种“美妙的性快感”，

sentences.en: before describing in obscene detail the pleasure he took in killing 11-year-old Josie Otero the same way.
sentences.zh: 随后用极其猥琐的细节描述了他用同样方式杀害11岁乔西·奥特罗时所获得的快感。

sentences.en: Ultimately, he said he gave up the idea of killing Shirley's children only because the ringing telephone spooked him.
sentences.zh: 最终，他说他放弃杀害雪莉孩子的想法，仅仅是因为电话铃声把他吓到了。

sentences.en: Fearing the unanswered call might prompt someone to visit the house and check in on the family, he ended his plans prematurely to secure his escape.
sentences.zh: 由于担心无人接听的电话会促使某人来家里探望并查看这家人，他提前终止了计划以确保自己能够脱身。

sentences.en: BTK expressed frustration that a poem he claimed to have previously sent to the Wichita Regal about Shirley Vianne hadn't received media attention.
sentences.zh: BTK对媒体没有关注他此前声称发给《威奇托鹰报》关于雪莉·维安妮的诗歌表示沮丧。

sentences.en: I find the newspaper not writing about the poem on Vianne unamusing, he wrote.
sentences.zh: 他写道：“我发现报纸不报道关于维安妮的诗真是无趣。”

sentences.en: A little paragraph would have been enough.
sentences.zh: 一个小段落就足够了。

sentences.en: I know it's not the news media's fault.
sentences.zh: 我知道这不是新闻媒体的错。

sentences.en: He went on to blame Police Chief Richard Lemunion for the lack of coverage, even though neither he nor anyone at the Eagle's office had any knowledge of the supposed poem.
sentences.zh: 他接着将缺乏报道的原因归咎于警察局长理查德·莱穆尼恩，《鹰报》办公室的任何人对这首所谓的诗都一无所知。

sentences.en: The police chief, he keeps things quiet and doesn't let the public know there is a psycho running around loose strangling mostly women, BTK complained.
sentences.zh: BTK抱怨道：“警察局长，他把事情捂得很紧，不让公众知道有个变态四处流窜，专门勒死女人。”

sentences.en: Following this revelation, staff at the Wichita Eagle reviewed all their recently received mail.
sentences.zh: 这一消息曝光后，《威奇托鹰报》的工作人员查阅了他们最近收到的所有信件。

sentences.en: In the classified advertising department's dead letter pile, they found a 3x5-inch index card which had arrived 9 days earlier.
sentences.zh: 在分类广告部的死信堆里，他们发现了一张9天前寄到的3x5英寸索引卡。

sentences.en: Stamped onto it with the children's rubber letter kit was a short, poorly written poem.
sentences.zh: 上面用儿童橡胶字母工具印着一首简短、写得很烂的诗。

sentences.en: It was an adaptation of the children's nursery rhyme Curly Locks about a girl who gets lost in the woods and befriends three bears who live in a cabin.
sentences.zh: 这是对儿童童谣《卷发女孩》的改编，讲的是一个女孩在树林里迷路，并与住在小屋里的三只熊成为朋友的故事。

sentences.en: The index card version referenced Shirley Vianne.
sentences.zh: 索引卡版本提到了雪莉·维安妮。

sentences.en: Shirley Locks, Shirley Locks, will to thou be mine.
sentences.zh: 雪莉锁，雪莉锁，你愿意成为我的吗？

sentences.en: Thou shall not scream, nor yet flee the line.
sentences.zh: 你既不准尖叫，也不准逃跑。

sentences.en: But lay on cushion, and think of me and death, and how it's going to be.
sentences.zh: 而是要躺在软垫上，想着我和死亡，以及将要发生的一切。

sentences.en: Signed BTK, it was followed by a postscript stating,
sentences.zh: 署名为BTK，后面跟着一个后记，写道：

sentences.en: Poem for Fox next.
sentences.zh: 下一首是写给福克斯的诗。

sentences.en: Given that the card didn't list a specific department or recipient at the Eagle, it had been inspected by a clerk in the mail room.
sentences.zh: 鉴于卡片上没有写明《鹰报》的具体部门或收件人，它是由收发室的一名职员检查的。

sentences.en: They assumed it was a cryptic Valentine's poem intended for the personals section in the paper's upcoming February 14 edition.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一首神秘的情人节诗歌，打算是用于该报即将出版的2月14日版面上的个人专栏。

sentences.en: The card was forwarded to classified advertising, but as it lacked the required payment for publication, it was ultimately discarded into the dead letter pile.
sentences.zh: 卡片被转交给分类广告部，但由于缺少出版所需的费用，最终被丢弃在死信堆里。

sentences.en: In the Cake TV letter, BTK attempted to offer an explanation for his crimes.
sentences.zh: 在“蛋糕电视”的信中，BTK试图为自己的罪行提供解释。

sentences.en: You don't understand, he wrote, because you're not under the influence of Factor X.
sentences.zh: 他写道：“你们不明白，因为你们没有受到X因子的影响。”

sentences.en: He blamed his actions on this vague, seemingly supernatural force, claiming it had also driven many other killers, including Jack the Ripper, Son of Sam, and the Boston Strangler.
sentences.zh: 他将自己的行为归咎于这种模糊的、看似超自然的力量，并声称这也驱使了许多其他杀手，包括开膛手杰克、山姆之子和波士顿绞杀者。

sentences.en: BTK appeared to draw inspiration from these other notorious killers.
sentences.zh: BTK似乎从这些其他声名狼藉的杀手身上汲取了灵感。

sentences.en: His crimes echoed aspects of theirs, and they too had taunted police through their writings.
sentences.zh: 他的罪行呼应了他们的某些方面，而且他们也曾通过文字嘲弄警方。

sentences.en: In the words of one psychiatrist,
sentences.zh: 用一位精神病专家的话来说，

sentences.en: BTK claimed the only cure for Factor X was death or being caught and put away.
sentences.zh: BTK声称治疗X因子的唯一方法就是死亡，或者被抓起来关禁闭。

sentences.en: He described living with it as a terrible nightmare, yet noted he didn't lose any sleep over it.
sentences.zh: 他将与它共同生活描述为一场可怕的噩梦，但也指出他并没有为此失眠。

sentences.en: The letter ended with BTK proposing a list of names he wished to be known by.
sentences.zh: 信的结尾，BTK提出了他希望被称呼的名字列表。

sentences.en: His first suggestion was the BTK Strangler, followed by alternatives such as Wichita Strangler, Poetic Strangler, and Bondage Strangler.
sentences.zh: 他的第一个建议是BTK绞杀者，其次是威奇托绞杀者、诗意绞杀者和捆绑绞杀者等备选方案。

sentences.en: He also offered darker monikers, including the Wichita Hangman or Executioner, the Garrett Phantom, the Asphyxiator, or simply just Psycho.
sentences.zh: 他还提供了更黑暗的称号，包括威奇托刽子手、加勒特幻影、窒息者，或者干脆叫变态。

sentences.en: But it was two specific lines in his letter that drew the most alarm.
sentences.zh: 但信中最让人感到惊恐的是两行特定的文字。

sentences.en: One read,
sentences.zh: 其中一句写道：

sentences.en: There are seven in the ground, who will be next?
sentences.zh: 地下有七个，下一个会是谁？

sentences.en: The other said,
sentences.zh: 另一句说道：

sentences.en: Seven down, and many more to go.
sentences.zh: 倒下七个，还有很多要去。

sentences.en: But the four members of the Otero family, in addition to Shirley Vianne and Nancy Fox, accounted for just six victiMs.
sentences.zh: 但奥特罗一家的四名成员，再加上雪莉·维安妮和南希·福克斯，总共只有六名受害者。

sentences.en: When it came to his unnamed seventh victim, BTK wrote,
sentences.zh: 当谈到他那名未透露姓名的第七名受害者时，BTK写道：

sentences.en: You guess motive and victim.
sentences.zh: 你们去猜动机和受害者吧。

sentences.en: Police Chief Richard Lemunian read BTK's latest letter slowly and silently.
sentences.zh: 警察局长理查德·莱穆尼恩缓慢而沉默地阅读着BTK的最新信件。

sentences.en: It was clear the man behind the persona relished not only notoriety and fear,
sentences.zh: 很显然，这个面具背后的男人不仅以恶名和恐惧为乐，

sentences.en: but also took pleasure in taunting the police by turning his unidentified victim into a puzzle he dared them to solve.
sentences.zh: 而且还通过将他未被识别的受害者变成一个他敢于让他们解开的谜题来嘲弄警方。

sentences.en: The way he numbered his known victims suggested that this murder had occurred after the Oteros, but before Shirley Vianne.
sentences.zh: 他为已知受害者编号的方式表明，这起谋杀案发生在奥特罗案之后、雪莉·维安妮案之前。

sentences.en: Lemunian began reviewing homicides from this three-year, two-month period, which had previously been considered a hiatus for the killer.
sentences.zh: 莱穆尼恩开始审查这段长达三年零两个月的凶杀案，这段时期此前被认为是该杀手的休眠期。

sentences.en: He found that just three months after the Otero murders, an incident occurred that, in hindsight, bore several familiar hallmarks.
sentences.zh: 他发现，就在奥特罗谋杀案发生三个月后，发生了一起事件，事后看来，这起事件带有几个熟悉的特征。

sentences.en: After midday on Thursday, April 4, 1974,
sentences.zh: 1974年4月4日星期四中午过后，

sentences.en: 21-year-old Catherine Bright arrived at her home on East 13th Street in northeast Wichita with her 19-year-old brother, Kevin.
sentences.zh: 21岁的凯瑟琳·布赖特和她19岁的弟弟凯文一起回到了位于威奇托东北部东13街的家中。

sentences.en: Kevin had spent the previous night at Catherine's house to avoid having to drive through recent snowfall.
sentences.zh: 凯文前一晚住在凯瑟琳家，以免开车穿过刚下的积雪。

sentences.en: As they entered the dwelling, the siblings were laughing about a joke Catherine had told.
sentences.zh: 当他们进入住宅时，姐弟俩还在为凯瑟琳讲的一个笑话开怀大笑。

sentences.en: They moved down a hallway and past a bedroom when a voice startled them.
sentences.zh: 他们走过一条走廊，经过一间卧室时，一个声音吓了他们一跳。

sentences.en: Hold it right there.
sentences.zh: 就站在那里别动。

sentences.en: Waiting for them was a man the siblings had never seen before.
sentences.zh: 等着他们的是一个姐弟俩从未见过的男人。

sentences.en: He was white, approximately 25 to 28 years old, just under 6 feet tall, and looked to weigh around 180 pounds.
sentences.zh: 他是白人，大约25到28岁，身高不到6英尺，体重看起来在180磅左右。

sentences.en: He had a few days' worth of stubble with a thick moustache that reached the corners of his mouth.
sentences.zh: 他留着几天的胡茬，嘴巴两侧长着浓密的髭须。

sentences.en: A yellow and black stocking cap covered his head, and a silver wristwatch with an expansion band was visible on his left wriSt.
sentences.zh: 头上戴着一顶黄黑相间的针织帽，左手腕上戴着一块带有弹性表带的银色手表。

sentences.en: He brandished an automatic pistol with gloved hands, while a revolver sat holstered in a shoulder rig on his left side.
sentences.zh: 他戴着手套挥舞着一把自动手枪，左侧肩带的枪套里则插着一把左轮手枪。

sentences.en: Catherine demanded to know who the man was and what he was doing in her home.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳质问这名男子是谁，在她的家里干什么。

sentences.en: He claimed he was wanted in California and needed provisions, specifically a car, money and firearms, to make a clean getaway to New York.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己在加利福尼亚遭到通缉，需要给养，具体来说是一辆汽车、钱和枪支，以便顺利逃往纽约。

sentences.en: The words the man used struck Kevin as odd.
sentences.zh: 这个男人使用的词汇让凯文觉得很奇怪。

sentences.en: He spoke as if he was reading from a turn-of-the-century detective novel, sounding far more polished and intelligent than his backstory implied.
sentences.zh: 他说话的语气就像是在读一本世纪之交的侦探小说，听起来比他的背景故事所暗示的要温文尔雅、聪明得多。

sentences.en: People just don't say provisions when they mean food, or firearms when they mean guns, Kevin thought.
sentences.zh: 凯文想，人们在指食物时不会说给养，在指枪时也不会说火器。

sentences.en: Stranger still, the man thought he recognised Kevin.
sentences.zh: 更奇怪的是，这个男人以为他认得凯文。

sentences.en: Don't I know you?
sentences.zh: 我难道不认识你吗？

sentences.en: I think I've seen you up by the university, he asked, seemingly in reference to Wichita State University.
sentences.zh: 我想我在大学附近见过你，他问道，似乎指的是威奇托州立大学。

sentences.en: There was little conversation after that.
sentences.zh: 在那之后没怎么交谈。

sentences.en: The man told Catherine and Kevin he was going to tie them up, but assured them they wouldn't be hurt.
sentences.zh: 这个男人告诉凯瑟琳和凯文他要绑起他们，但向他们保证他们不会受到伤害。

sentences.en: He said he was only there to rob them and would leave once he had what he needed.
sentences.zh: 他说他只是来抢劫的，一旦拿到他需要的东西就会离开。

sentences.en: Because he hadn't brought anything to bind the siblings, the man rummaged through a dresser and collected bandanas, belts, scarves, pantyhose and t-shirts.
sentences.zh: 由于他没有带任何用来捆绑姐弟俩的东西，这个男人在梳妆台里翻找，收集了头巾、皮带、围巾、连裤袜和T恤。

sentences.en: He then led them into another room and ordered Kevin to tie Catherine to a chair.
sentences.zh: 然后他把他们带到另一个房间，命令凯文把凯瑟琳绑在椅子上。

sentences.en: Afterwards, he forced Kevin into a front bedroom and ordered him to lie face down on the floor.
sentences.zh: 之后，他把凯文强行推进前卧室内，命令他脸朝下趴在地板上。

sentences.en: The man tied Kevin's hands behind his back, stuffed a washcloth into his mouth and then secured it with a scarf before leaving the room.
sentences.zh: 这个男人把凯文的双手反绑在身后，把一块毛巾塞进他嘴里，然后用围巾固定好，接着离开了房间。

sentences.en: Kevin heard the man rifling through the house, presumably searching for money.
sentences.zh: 凯文听到这个男人在屋里搜寻，大概是在找钱。

sentences.en: At one point, he turned a radio up so loud that it drowned out almost all other noise.
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，他把收音机声音开得极大，几乎盖住了所有其他的噪音。

sentences.en: Minutes later, the man returned to Kevin and asked if he thought he could untie himself.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，这个男人回到凯文身边，问他觉得自己能不能解开绳子。

sentences.en: Gagged, Kevin couldn't answer.
sentences.zh: 嘴被塞住的凯文无法回答。

sentences.en: The man then looped a pair of pantyhose around Kevin's neck and pulled tight.
sentences.zh: 然后，这个男人将一双连裤袜绕在凯文的脖子上并用力拉紧。

sentences.en: As Kevin felt his life slipping away, he thrashed desperately and managed to free his hands.
sentences.zh: 当凯文感觉到生命正离他而去时，他拼命挣扎，设法解放了自己的双手。

sentences.en: He stood and charged at the man, who quickly raised his pistol and fired.
sentences.zh: 他站起来向那个男人冲去，对方迅速举起手枪开枪。

sentences.en: The bullet hit Kevin, dropping him to the floor as blood pulled around his head.
sentences.zh: 子弹击中了凯文，把他击倒在地，鲜血在他头部周围汇聚成一滩。

sentences.en: The gunman then fled the room.
sentences.zh: 枪手随后逃离了房间。

sentences.en: From across the house,
sentences.zh: 从屋子的另一头，

sentences.en: Catherine screamed,
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳尖叫道：

sentences.en: What have you done to my brother?
sentences.zh: 你对我弟弟做了什么？

sentences.en: The man eventually returned to Kevin, only to discover that he was still alive.
sentences.zh: 这个男人最终回到了凯文身边，却发现他还活着。

sentences.en: The bullet had only grazed his forehead.
sentences.zh: 子弹只是擦伤了他的前额。

sentences.en: A violent struggle ensued as the man attempted to strangle Kevin again.
sentences.zh: 随着这个男人再次试图勒死凯文，一场激烈的搏斗随即展开。

sentences.en: Kevin clawed at the revolver in the man's shoulder holster and had almost wedged his finger against the trigger when the man drew his pistol and shot Kevin again.
sentences.zh: 凯文抓挠着那个男人肩枪套里的左轮手枪，几乎把手指卡在了扳机上，这时那个男人拔出枪再次向凯文开枪。

sentences.en: Kevin went limp as blood gushed from another wound in his head.
sentences.zh: 随着鲜血从头部的另一个伤口涌出，凯文瘫软了下来。

sentences.en: By this point, the man had lost all control and composure.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，这个男人已经失去了所有的控制和镇定。

sentences.en: Sweat dripped down his tired face.
sentences.zh: 汗水顺着他疲惫的脸庞滴落。

sentences.en: Believing Kevin was finally dead, he left the room once more.
sentences.zh: 他以为凯文终于死了，便再次离开了房间。

sentences.en: Against all odds,
sentences.zh: 在所有人都意想不到的情况下，

sentences.en: Kevin was still alive.
sentences.zh: 凯文仍然活着。

sentences.en: The second bullet had struck his upper jaw, knocking out two teeth.
sentences.zh: 第二颗子弹击中了她的上颌，打掉了两颗牙齿。

sentences.en: He lay still, playing dead, until he heard his sister moaning in distress in the other room.
sentences.zh: 他静静地躺着，装死，直到听到他的姐姐在另一个房间痛苦地呻吟。

sentences.en: Kevin tried to formulate a plan.
sentences.zh: 凯文试图制定一个计划。

sentences.en: Despite the reassurances the intruder had given them, it was clear he had intended to kill them both from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 尽管闯入者给过他们保证，但很显然他从一开始就打算杀死他们两个。

sentences.en: Kevin knew he was unlikely to survive another confrontation in his condition.
sentences.zh: 凯文知道以他目前的情况，在另一次对抗中很难存活下来。

sentences.en: Summoning the little strength he had left,
sentences.zh: 鼓起最后的一点力气，

sentences.en: Kevin got up and snuck out the front door.
sentences.zh: 凯文站起身，从前门溜了出去。

sentences.en: He ran out onto the street and flagged down a passing car.
sentences.zh: 他跑向街道，拦下了一辆路过的汽车。

sentences.en: Bleeding from the head with the pair of pantyhose still around his neck,
sentences.zh: 头部流着血，脖子上还缠着那双连裤袜，

sentences.en: Kevin told the two men inside the car about the gunman.
sentences.zh: 凯文向车里的两个男人讲述了枪手的事情。

sentences.en: He's in there now, doing a number on my sister.
sentences.zh: 他现在就在里面，正在对我姐姐下毒手。

sentences.en: The driver rushed Kevin to the hospital while the passenger went to call 911.
sentences.zh: 司机紧急将凯文送往医院，而乘客则去拨打911。

sentences.en: Police radios crackled with reports of a residence robbery in progress as officers Dennis Landon and Raymond Fletcher raced to the scene.
sentences.zh: 警用无线电里充斥着住宅抢劫正在进行的报告，警官丹尼斯·兰登和雷蒙德·弗莱彻赶往现场。

sentences.en: Catherine's house was still and silent when Officer Fletcher approached the front door and knocked.
sentences.zh: 当弗莱彻警官走近前门并敲门时，凯瑟琳的房子依然平静而寂静。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Officer Landon went to the rear of the property and noticed the glass in the back door was broken, revealing the intruder's entry point.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，兰登警官来到房产后方，发现后门玻璃碎了，露出了闯入者的入口。

sentences.en: As Landon moved into the house, he sighted a young woman lying face down in a pool of blood outside a bedroom.
sentences.zh: 当兰登走进房子时，他看到一个年轻女子脸朝下躺在卧室外的血泊中。

sentences.en: It was Catherine Bright.
sentences.zh: 她正是凯瑟琳·布赖特。

sentences.en: She was cold and clammy and her face was tinged with a bluish hue.
sentences.zh: 她浑身冰凉湿冷，面色带着一丝蓝调。

sentences.en: Pantyhose was tied tightly around her ankles and another pair secured her wrists.
sentences.zh: 她的脚踝上紧紧绑着连裤袜，手腕上也固定着另一双。

sentences.en: A blue scarf and a length of white rope were looped loosely around her neck and tangled in her hair.
sentences.zh: 一条蓝色围巾和一段白绳松垮地绕在她的脖子上，纠缠在她的头发里。

sentences.en: Officer Landon carefully rolled Catherine over.
sentences.zh: 兰登警官小心翼翼地把凯瑟琳翻过身来。

sentences.en: She was still alive and begged him to untie her legs.
sentences.zh: 她还活着，并恳求他解开她的腿。

sentences.en: Landon cut through the pantyhose using a pocket knife and Officer Fletcher arrived as an ambulance was summoned.
sentences.zh: 兰登用小刀割断了连裤袜，这时弗莱彻警官赶到，救护车也被召唤了过来。

sentences.en: With Catherine teetering on the edge of consciousness, the two officers questioned her to gather as much information as possible.
sentences.zh: 由于凯瑟琳处于意识模糊的边缘，两名警官对她进行了盘问，以搜集尽可能多的信息。

sentences.en: When asked what had happened,
sentences.zh: 当被问及发生了什么时，

sentences.en: Catherine lifted her blouse, revealing several open wounds in her abdomen.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳掀起上衣，露出了腹部的几处开放性伤口。

sentences.en: The officers pressed kitchen rags to the injuries and elevated Catherine's legs.
sentences.zh: 警员们用厨房抹布按住伤口，并抬高了凯瑟琳的双腿。

sentences.en: She managed to tell them that she didn't know her attacker, who had since fled.
sentences.zh: 她设法告诉他们，自己并不认识袭击者，对方已经逃跑了。

sentences.en: At one point,
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，

sentences.en: Catherine grabbed Fletcher's arm and repeated,
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳抓住了弗莱彻的手臂并重复道，

sentences.en: I can't breathe.
sentences.zh: 我喘不过气来。

sentences.en: Help me.
sentences.zh: 救救我。

sentences.en: He tried to keep her calm, but her pupils remained fixed and blank and her breathing grew increasingly shallow.
sentences.zh: 他试图让她平静下来，但她的瞳孔依然呆滞涣散，呼吸也越来越浅。

sentences.en: Catherine had been stabbed five times in the front and twice in the back.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳胸前被刺了五刀，背部被刺了两刀。

sentences.en: She muttered, one more help me as she was taken into surgery, but died of her injuries while on the operating table.
sentences.zh: 她在被推入手术室时喃喃地说着“再帮帮我”，但最终因伤势过重死在了手术台上。

sentences.en: Despite being shot twice in the head, her brother Kevin miraculously survived.
sentences.zh: 尽管头部中了两枪，她的哥哥凯文却奇迹般地活了下来。

sentences.en: The crime scene suggested a violent robbery, yet something about it didn't quite add up.
sentences.zh: 案发现场看起来像是一起暴力抢劫，但又有些地方说不通。

sentences.en: The contents of Catherine's purse were scattered beneath the table in the entryway and several of her dresser drawers had been rifled through, yet nothing appeared to be missing.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳钱包里的物品散落在门厅的桌子下方，几个梳妆台抽屉也被翻得乱七八糟，然而似乎没有什么东西丢失。

sentences.en: Kevin's recollections allowed investigators to create a suspect sketch, but it didn't match any offenders wanted in California.
sentences.zh: 凯文的回忆让调查人员绘制出了一张嫌疑人画像，但这与加州任何通缉的罪犯都不吻合。

sentences.en: When no leads emerged, a $5,000 reward was offered and the case was added to the secret witness program alongside the still-unsolved
sentences.zh: 在没有任何线索出现的情况下，悬赏金额提高到了五千美元，该案也被加入了秘密证人计划，与至今未破的案件并列：

sentences.en: Otero murders.
sentences.zh: 奥特罗谋杀案。

sentences.en: Investigators did consider whether the two cases were linked, as both involved fatal home invasions, but the differences made any connections extremely tenuous.
sentences.zh: 调查人员确实考虑过这两起案件是否有联系，因为两起案件都涉及致命的入室抢劫，但差异使得任何关联都显得极其微弱。

sentences.en: The Otero killer brought his own restraints, whereas Catherine and Kevin were bound with items from Catherine's home.
sentences.zh: 奥特罗案的凶手带来了自己的束缚工具，而凯瑟琳和凯文则是用凯瑟琳家中的物品被绑住的。

sentences.en: Even the knots differed, with clove hitches used on the Oteros and granny knots for the Brights.
sentences.zh: 甚至连结法都不同，奥特罗案使用的是双半结，而布赖特案使用的是平结。

sentences.en: The killer broke into the Bright residence and lay in wait, whereas he entered the Otero home when the family was present.
sentences.zh: 凶手是闯入布赖特住宅后潜伏等待，而他进入奥特罗家时家人正在场。

sentences.en: Catherine's phone lines were intact and the Bright scene contained no sexual undertones, while none of the Oteros had been shot or stabbed.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的电话线完好无损，布赖特案现场也没有性侵的暗示，而奥特罗一家的任何人都没有被枪击或刺伤。

sentences.en: Coincidentally, police officer Raymond Fletcher, one of the first responders at the Brights scene, was also the first to arrive at Shirley Vianne's murder three years later.
sentences.zh: 巧合的是，作为布赖特案的第一批出警人员之一，警员雷蒙德·弗莱彻也是三年后第一个抵达雪莉·维安妮谋杀案现场的人。

sentences.en: While Fletcher immediately recognised
sentences.zh: 虽然弗莱彻立刻认出

sentences.en: Shirley as likely being a victim of BTK, he didn't draw the same conclusion with Catherine.
sentences.zh: 雪莉很可能是BTK的受害者，但他对凯瑟琳却没有得出同样的结论。

sentences.en: In the letter sent to Cake TV following the murder of Nancy Fox,
sentences.zh: 在南希·福克斯遇害后寄给蛋糕电视台的信中，

sentences.en: BTK taunted,
sentences.zh: BTK嘲讽道：

sentences.en: Did the cops think that all those deaths are not related?
sentences.zh: 警察难道认为所有这些死亡事件都没有关联吗？

sentences.en: Golly gee.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Yes, the MO is different in each, but look, a pattern is developing.
sentences.zh: 没错，每起案件的作案手法都不同，但瞧，一种模式正在形成。

sentences.en: The victims are tied up, most have been women, phone cut, bring some bondage, sadist tendencies, no struggle, outside the death spot, no witnesses, except Vianne's kids.
sentences.zh: 受害者都被绑了起来，大多数是女性，电话线被剪断，带来了一些束缚工具，有虐待狂倾向，没有挣扎，死亡地点在室外，没有目击者，除了维安妮的孩子们。

sentences.en: Police Chief Richard
sentences.zh: 警察局长理查德

sentences.en: Lemonyan deduced that Catherine Bright was likely BTK's unknown victim.
sentences.zh: 莱莫尼安推断，凯瑟琳·布赖特很可能是BTK未知的受害者。

sentences.en: While the pattern was evident, it was incomplete.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种模式很明显，但它并不完整。

sentences.en: It appeared that BTK had intended to carry out his signature killing, but when Kevin Bright escaped, the plan was cut short, much like what happened with Shirley Vianne.
sentences.zh: 看来BTK本打算实施他标志性的谋杀，但当凯文·布赖特逃脱时，计划被打断了，这与雪莉·维安妮遭遇的情况非常相似。

sentences.en: He likely altered his methods in subsequent killings, such as abandoning the use of a knife to avoid being linked back to the Bright case.
sentences.zh: 他很可能在之后的谋杀中改变了方法，例如放弃使用刀具，以避免被重新牵扯到布赖特案中。

sentences.en: Lemonyan suspected
sentences.zh: 莱莫尼安怀疑，

sentences.en: BTK had avoided naming Catherine in his letter not merely as a part of a depraved guessing game with authorities, but because the crime had been sloppy and riddled with mistakes.
sentences.zh: BTK在信中没有提及凯瑟琳，不仅是因为他与当局在进行一场变态的猜谜游戏，而是因为这起犯罪过于草率且漏洞百出。

sentences.en: Most significantly,
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，

sentences.en: Kevin's survival presented a major threat.
sentences.zh: 凯文的幸存构成了巨大的威胁。

sentences.en: He provided a reliable and credible account of his sister's murder, including a detailed physical description of her killer and his possible connection to
sentences.zh: 他提供了关于妹妹遇害的可靠且可信的陈述，包括凶手的详细外貌特征以及他可能与

sentences.en: Wichita State University.
sentences.zh: 威奇托州立大学有关。

sentences.en: How many do I have to kill before I get a name in the paper or some national attention?
sentences.zh: 我到底得杀多少人，才能让我的名字登上报纸或引起全国的关注？

sentences.en: BTK threatened in his Cake TV letter.
sentences.zh: BTK在写给蛋糕电视台的信中威胁道。

sentences.en: Up until that point,
sentences.zh: 在此之前，

sentences.en: Chief Lemonyan had kept news of the serial killer under wraps to maintain order.
sentences.zh: 莱莫尼安局长为了维持秩序，一直对连环杀手的消息保密。

sentences.en: But now, with seven confirmed victims and threats of more,
sentences.zh: 但现在，随着七名受害者得到证实以及更多的威胁，

sentences.en: Lemonyan spoke with Cake TV's news director.
sentences.zh: 莱莫尼安与蛋糕电视台的新闻总监进行了交谈。

sentences.en: He fully expected the chief to urge him to bury the story entirely.
sentences.zh: 他本完全预计局长会敦促他彻底将这个新闻压下去。

sentences.en: But, to his surprise,
sentences.zh: 但令他惊讶的是，

sentences.en: Lemonyan said,
sentences.zh: 莱莫尼安说道：

sentences.en: For the good of everybody, it's time we tell what we know.
sentences.zh: 为了每个人的利益，是时候把我们知道的说出来了。

sentences.en: We've got to warn people.
sentences.zh: 我们必须警告大家。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 案卷档案稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持案卷档案继续为您提供优质内容。

sentences.en: That evening,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，

sentences.en: Chief Lemonyan held a press conference in which he announced,
sentences.zh: 莱莫尼安局长举行了一场新闻发布会，他在会上宣布：

sentences.en: The purpose of this news conference is to advise the public of an extremely serious matter involving a series of murders which have occurred in our city.
sentences.zh: 召开这次新闻发布会的目的是为了就发生在我们城市的一系列谋杀案这一极其严重的事态，向公众发出通报。

sentences.en: This person has consistently identified himself with the initials BTK and wishes to be known as the BTK Strangler.
sentences.zh: 此人一直用BTK的首字母缩写来表明自己的身份，并希望被称为“BTK勒死者”。

sentences.en: The decision for the police to officially go public with the news of BTK had its detractors.
sentences.zh: 警方决定正式公开BTK的消息，这一举动并非没有反对者。

sentences.en: Even Lemonyan had doubts.
sentences.zh: 就连莱莫尼安也心存疑虑。

sentences.en: If BTK struck again, the Chief worried he would be blamed for provoking him through the publicity.
sentences.zh: 局长担心，如果BTK再次作案，他会被指责是通过公开消息刺激了凶手。

sentences.en: Yet, he faced seven unsolved murders and the public remained oblivious to the danger.
sentences.zh: 然而，他面对的是七起未破的谋杀案，而公众对危险仍一无所知。

sentences.en: Before the conference,
sentences.zh: 在发布会之前，

sentences.en: Lemonyan consulted several psychologists to determine whether publicly announcing the case might prompt to BTK to communicate again and provide valuable intelligence.
sentences.zh: 莱莫尼安咨询了几位心理学家，以确定公开此案是否会促使BTK再次与外界沟通并提供有价值的情报。

sentences.en: Their guidance persuaded him to move forward.
sentences.zh: 他们的指导说服了他继续推进此事。

sentences.en: Calmly and with resolve,
sentences.zh: 平静而坚定地，

sentences.en: Lemonyan informed the people of Wichita that a serial killer was among them.
sentences.zh: 莱莫尼安向威奇托市民告知，一个连环杀手就在他们中间。

sentences.en: He also addressed the difficult question of why news of BTK had been withheld for so long.
sentences.zh: 他还回应了一个棘手的问题，即为什么隐瞒BTK的消息长达这么久。

sentences.en: We felt the lack of news coverage would forestall any more killings.
sentences.zh: 我们当时觉得，缺乏新闻报道会阻止更多的谋杀发生。

sentences.en: That was what was hoped at the time, he admitted, before adding that investigators were never fully certain all the murders were connected until recently.
sentences.zh: 他承认，当时是抱着这种希望的，接着补充说，调查人员直到最近才完全确定所有的谋杀案都是相互关联的。

sentences.en: There were, of course, very definite similarities, but at the same time, there were very significant differences.
sentences.zh: 当然，它们有着非常明显的相似之处，但与此同时，又存在着非常巨大的差异。

sentences.en: Lemonyan explained that the police had every reason to believe
sentences.zh: 莱莫尼安解释说，警方完全有理由相信，

sentences.en: BTK had the capability to kill again, but they didn't know if, when, or where he might strike next.
sentences.zh: BTK有能力再次杀人，但他们不知道他接下来是否会、会在何时或何地动手。

sentences.en: Worse still, they had no worthwhile leads or suspects.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，他们没有任何有价值的线索或嫌疑人。

sentences.en: He urged residents to remain vigilant.
sentences.zh: 他敦促居民保持警惕。

sentences.en: After murdering Nancy Fox,
sentences.zh: 在谋杀南希·福克斯后，

sentences.en: BTK wrote that he simply went home and carried on with his life, quote, like anyone else.
sentences.zh: BTK写道，他只是回家继续过他的生活，“引用原话，就像其他人一样”。

sentences.en: He went on to warn,
sentences.zh: 他接着警告说：

sentences.en: Based on this information,
sentences.zh: 基于这些信息，

sentences.en: Lemonyan emphasised that BTK wouldn't appear to be an obvious monster within their community, nor would he seem insane.
sentences.zh: 莱莫尼安强调，BTK在他们社区里看起来不会是一个显眼的恶魔，他看起来也不会是个疯子。

sentences.en: He would be hiding in plain sight, living a seemingly normal life outside of his crimes and appearing like any ordinary man in every respect.
sentences.zh: 他会隐藏在眼皮底下，在犯罪之余过着看似正常的生活，在方方面面都表现得像个普通人。

sentences.en: A psychologist agreed, explaining,
sentences.zh: 一位心理学家表示赞同，他解释说：

sentences.en: I don't think one could get very close to the guy, but he might not appear particularly different superficially.
sentences.zh: 我认为没人能真正接近这家伙，但从表面上看，他可能并没有什么特别的不同。

sentences.en: FBI criminal profilers suspected BTK was a lone wolf in his mid-thirties who performed well at work but rarely stayed in one job as he disliked being told what to do.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局的犯罪心理画像专家推测，BTK是一个三十多岁独来独往的人，他在工作中表现出色，但很少在同一个工作岗位上呆太久，因为他不喜欢别人对他的行为指手画脚。

sentences.en: He likely had military training and an interest in law enforcement, reading detective magazines that gave insight into police procedures and ways to avoid detection.
sentences.zh: 他很可能受过军事训练，并且对执法工作感兴趣，喜欢阅读能够深入了解警方侦破程序以及如何逃避侦查的侦探杂志。
